name: likert-scale
title: Likert scale
description: Agree or disagree in five labelled steps: horizontal with a label under each step, a single column on a phone and one tab stop.
docs: value is the number of the chosen point, counted from 1, or "na" for the Not applicable choice, or null for no answer; onValueChange reports the number or "na". points (5 or 7) chooses the default labels, Strongly disagree to Strongly agree; options replaces them with your own, such as ["Never", "Rarely", "Sometimes", "Often", "Always"]. The layout follows the width of the container, not the screen: from 520px the points sit in a row on a line, below it they stack as a column of large targets. required makes the group aria-required and a form refuse to submit until a point is chosen; the missing answer shows as an error under the group (requiredMessage) once the group has been left or a submit was tried. error shows a message from outside. notApplicable adds a choice that stands apart, with your own words if you pass a string. name sends the number, or na, with a plain form.
